title: Yellowed Crispy Italian Sausage Orecchiette
description: A high-protein Italian dish featuring crispy Italian sausage and orecchiette pasta, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe incorporates vegetable shortening and a robata-grill for a unique flavor and texture.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the orecchiette pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable shortening over medium-high heat.
Add the Italian sausage to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the skillet and set aside.
Add the olive oil, cherry tomatoes, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder to the skillet and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the cooked orecchiette pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the tomato mixture.
Add the cooked Italian sausage back to the skillet and toss to combine with the pasta and tomato mixture.
Transfer the pasta mixture to the preheated robata-grill and cook for 2 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned and crispy.
Remove the pasta from the grill and top with shredded grana padano cheese.
Return the pasta to the grill and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
